name: No-U-Turn Sampler (NUTS)
summary: Adapt HMC integration path lengths to reduce manual tuning for posterior sampling.
summary_zh: 利用轨迹折返判据自动决定哈密顿蒙特卡洛的积分长度。
core_idea: Adapt Hamiltonian trajectory length using a turning criterion and step-size adaptation.
innovation: Reduces a major tuning burden in gradient-based MCMC, often valuable for moderately dimensional inverses.
limitations: Still expensive when each potential energy gradient requires a PDE solve.

start_here.why: Definitive NUTS paper explaining adaptive path length and HMC tuning.
start_here.focus: Turning criterion, trajectory construction and adaptation.
